content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: After typing into the Due Date field on sales invoice:new (input_activity 345), a visible validation error appears (353:a358) and the user then clicks Save (600), which raises another visible error (603:e639) without the form being saved.", "fix": "Fix: On the sales invoice:new Due Date input, run the existing Due Date validation on blur and show its message inline beneath the Due Date field, so the error appears while the user is editing rather than only after clicking Save.", "cited_event_ids": ["345", "353:a358", "600", "603:e639", "356:a365", "607:e662"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The text of the validation error is not in the events, so the specific rule that fails is unknown.", "Whether the user abandoned the form because of the error is inferred from the insight outcome, not observed in the events.", "Fields edited between the error and the Back navigation are not fully traceable to a cause."]}
